body: Pankaj Goyal (CFO) on 2026-05-22 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "Looking ahead, we expect total capex for FY '27 to be in the range of Rs.450 crores to Rs.500 crores" Metric: Capex FY27. Target: INR 450-500 cr. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: pending. Evidence: H1FY27 spend ~INR 378 cr; additional INR 500 cr programme approved 2026-11-06.
